title: Inngest idempotency conformance battery — 13 probes, 0 FAIL (2 DX findings filed inngest/inngest#5091)

subject.sut_note: SUT = unmodified npm dist packages; runtime-side verification via inngest-cli@1.49.0 dev server, local only (Gate D: CLI is SSPL 1.0 + Apache 2.0 Future License, sha256 300ec5a8..., verified pre-run; no vendor-operated service touched). Probe rules pre-registered in harness app.mjs header before the run. Run #2 (2026-10-26T20:24:53Z) is canonical: run #1 (2026-10-26T19:33Z) produced identical verdicts; run #1 raw evidence lost to a lab environment reset

scenarios.name: InngestH1Static
scenarios.checks: 5 probes, in-process via the vendor's own @inngest/test harness. I1 PASS: replay of a completed step returns the memoized result, body not re-run. I2/I4 OBSERVED: commit-then-throw and lost-memo crash model re-execute the step body — matches the vendor's blog FAQ and docs idempotency page nearly verbatim. I3/I3b OBSERVED: memo keyed by userland step ID without payload binding; parallel branches reusing one step ID execute independently — ID model documented under 'Keep step IDs stable'

scenarios.name: InngestI5Dynamic
scenarios.checks: 8 probes against the local dev server with a crash-safe external effect ledger. p0 PASS: baseline memo integrity, 1 charge. p4b/p4c/p4d PASS: documented event-ID dedup holds under a 12-way concurrent race (1 run / 1 charge), under sequential reuse (0 runs), fresh-ID control fires exactly once. p1/p2 OBSERVED: true A3 window reproduced live — provider commits, then step body throws (retry, ~24.5s backoff) or process.exit(1) (supervisor restart) — 2 charges, exactly as the vendor discloses. p3 OBSERVED (refined): duplicate step ID across parallel chains is warned (AUTOMATIC_PARALLEL_INDEXING) and auto-indexed into a separate memo slot, both handlers execute. p4a OBSERVED: 12 concurrent sends without a shared event ID produce 12 independent runs, the documented per-event model

findings_summary.title: @inngest/test does not surface AUTOMATIC_PARALLEL_INDEXING or any execution warnings: tests pass silently on code the runtime explicitly flags as a footgun
@inngest/test MockedStep memo injection is keyed by userland step ID and bypasses runtime collision indexing (auto-indexed keys unreachable from the test engine), with no divergence flag

Commit-then-crash window (external effect lands before memo write; retry re-runs the body) is documented by the vendor (docs idempotency page 'Verify the behavior', blog FAQ) and confirmed to behave exactly as documented; the vendor's prescribed mitigations (event-ID dedup; idempotency key at the external call) verified effective under a 12-way concurrent race

notes: Scope: single-node dev server; idempotency claim surface per vendor docs, methodology anchored to the vendor's own 'Verify the behavior' checklist. Multi-node/cloud dedup semantics, flow control, timers/cron, retry-exhaustion terminal states, and payment-rail scenarios are out of scope for this cycle (no vendor cloud engagement). Verdict taxonomy: PASS = platform held beyond the documented scenarios; OBSERVED = observed behavior matches the vendor's published disclosure. Neither attests bug-freeness.
